interventions.description: Construct continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide a safe, separated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks to provide designated points for pedestrians to cross the multi-lane road.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Signals
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and pedestrian-actuated signals to provide designated and protected crossing points.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical separation and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Reducing the number and width of driveways to minimize conflict points and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Installing a high-visibility marked crosswalk, potentially with a pedestrian refuge island or RRFB, to provide a safe crossing point.
